description: RFC 9727 api-catalog: override GitHub Pages octet-stream with application/linkset+json.
notes: GitHub Pages cannot emit a custom Content-Type for the extensionless /.well-known/api-catalog path. islandmountain.io is proxied by Cloudflare in front of Pages, so this rule lives on the existing zone ruleset 'Security response headers' (phase http_response_headers_transform).

ADD this rule. Do not replace the existing security-header rewrite, the homepage Link rule (ref homepage_rfc9727_link_headers), or the Tier A COOP/HSTS rule (ref tier_a_coop_hsts_preload). Do not PUT the whole ruleset with only this payload; a full ruleset replace would wipe live CSP, XFO, Link, COOP, and HSTS.

Zone: islandmountain.io. Ruleset id from prior Link-headers / Tier A work: c0fae000097143e0ba49736efbe36c87. Confirm with GET /zones/$ZONE_ID/rulesets/phases/http_response_headers_transform/entrypoint before applying if that id is ever rotated.
Match is path-only and tight: http.request.uri.path eq "/.well-known/api-catalog". uri.path ignores the query string, so a trailing query still matches. A trailing slash does not.
Do not change the placeholder JSON body at .well-known/api-catalog. Do not invent OpenAPI or a product API surface. Do not touch Cloudflare /lamprey redirects.

dashboard: Cloudflare Dashboard > islandmountain.io > Rules > Overview (or Transform Rules) > Modify Response Header.
Add a new rule. Do not edit the existing security-header rewrite, the homepage Link rule, or the Tier A COOP/HSTS rule.
When incoming requests match: Custom filter expression `http.request.uri.path eq "/.well-known/api-catalog"`.
Then: Set static header Content-Type = application/linkset+json.
Deploy. Confirm the older security-header rule, homepage Link rule, and Tier A rule are still enabled.
api: Additive create-rule only: POST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$ZONE_ID/rulesets/$RULESET_ID/rules with this object (minus notes/enable).
Do not PUT https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$ZONE_ID/rulesets/$RULESET_ID with a rules array that contains only this rule.
After enable: curl -sI https://islandmountain.io/.well-known/api-catalog must show Content-Type: application/linkset+json.
